title: Guided Nature Walks
description: Explore our property and surrounding areas with expert naturalists. Learn about endemic species, medicinal plants, and conservation efforts. Perfect for all fitness levels.

title: Farm Tours
description: Get hands-on experience with our organic farming practices. Tour the mango and coconut orchards, learn about sustainable agriculture, and enjoy seasonal fruit picking.

title: Carriage Rides
description: Scenic rides around the property at sunset for a magical experience. Perfect for couples or families wanting a unique way to explore the grounds.

title: Birdwatching
description: Early-morning guided birding excursions to spot rare Western Ghats species. Binoculars provided. Best season: November to March.

title: Sunrise Viewpoint
description: Wake up early for a guided walk to our best sunrise viewpoint. Enjoy panoramic views of the Western Ghats while sipping hot chai.

title: Yoga & Meditation
description: Start your day with outdoor yoga sessions in our garden pavilion. Private and group sessions available. Mats and props provided.
